name: PromptInput
description: A multi-line prompt box for chat and AI tools: text on top, tools such as Attach and voice on the left, a model picker and a send button on the right. Enter sends.
whenToUse: For an AI assistant or chat composer where people write a message or prompt.
For any free-text input that is sent with a button, such as a comment box with attachments.

whenNotToUse.text: For a single line, such as a search.
For a long document or form field with a label above.

anatomy.name: Field
anatomy.description: The text area where people type.

anatomy.name: Tools
anatomy.description: Controls at the start of the bottom row, e.g. Attach.

anatomy.name: Actions
anatomy.description: Controls at the end, e.g. a model picker.

anatomy.name: Send
anatomy.description: Submits the prompt; disabled while the field is empty.

states.name: Empty
states.meaning: No text; the send button is disabled.

states.name: Ready
states.meaning: Text present; the send button is enabled.

states.name: Focus
states.meaning: The border shows focus around the whole box.

states.name: Busy
states.meaning: A reply is being produced; the send button shows a spinner and sending waits.

states.name: Disabled
states.meaning: Nothing can be typed or sent.

behavior.text: Enter sends; Shift+Enter starts a new line. Whitespace-only text does not send.
Pass value and onValueChange to control the text, or defaultValue to let it manage its own; it clears after sending when uncontrolled.
Text runs from the right in Arabic; the row order flips with the layout.

content: Use a placeholder that shows what to type, e.g. "Ask me anything…".
Name the box with label so screen readers announce its purpose.

guidelines.do: Keep tools and the send button on one bottom row.
guidelines.why: One row keeps the composer predictable, as people expect in chat tools.

guidelines.do: Disable send while the field is empty.
guidelines.dont: Let people send empty messages and show an error.
guidelines.why: Disabling prevents the mistake before it happens.

guidelines.do: Let Enter send and Shift+Enter add a line.
guidelines.dont: Make Enter add a line and require a click to send.
guidelines.why: Keyboard users expect Enter to send in chat composers.

accessibility.role: form with a labelled multi-line text field.

keyboard.action: Sends the prompt when it has text.
Moves through the tools, actions and the send button.

aria.when: The text field is named by label.
Set on the send button from submitLabel.

accessibility.focus: The composer border shows focus; controls show their own focus rings.

wcag.how: The field is labelled by a real label element.
Sending works with Enter, and every control is reachable with Tab.
The placeholder supplements the label; it does not replace it.

notes: Disabled sending is announced by the button’s disabled state.

examples.title: Assistant prompt
examples.description: The composer with Attach and a send button.

examples.title: With a model picker
examples.description: A model picker in the actions row.
examples.code:
import { PromptInput } from '@ds/react';

<PromptInput label="Message" actions={<ModelPicker value={model} onValueChange={setModel} />} />

examples.title: In a side panel
examples.description: The small size for narrow panels.
examples.code:
import { PromptInput } from '@ds/react';

<PromptInput label="Reply" size="small" rows={2} onSubmit={reply} />

related.relation: For longer text inside a form with a visible label.
For a single line of search.

components.name: PromptInput
components.description:
A multi-line prompt box for chat and AI tools: text on top, tools and actions in a bottom row,
and a send button. Enter sends; Shift+Enter starts a new line.

label.description: Names the prompt box for screen readers, e.g. "Message the assistant".

onSubmit.description: Called with the text when the prompt is sent (Enter, or the send button).

tools.description: Controls at the start of the bottom row, e.g. Attach and voice input.

actions.description: Controls at the end, before the send button, e.g. a model picker.

submitLabel.description: Words for the send button. Default "Send".

busy.description: Shows a busy state on the send button and stops sending, e.g. while a reply is generated.

size.description: `small` for side panels, `medium` (default) for the main composer.

rows.description: Visible lines before the box scrolls. Default 3.

--prompt-input-small-gap.description: Tightest gap between tightly related items, e.g. icon and label.

--prompt-input-border-radius.description: Controls and small surfaces: inputs, buttons, menu items.

--prompt-input-border-color.description: Outline of text fields, selects and comboboxes; the lightest gray with 3:1 contrast.

--prompt-input-focus-border-color.description: Emphasized tone outline, e.g. a selected card.

--prompt-input-bg-color.description: Cards, panels, inputs and menus sitting on --color-bg-default.

--prompt-input-shadow-y.description: Shadow offset/blur steps in px (see --shadow-* in themes/shadow.css).

--prompt-input-shadow-blur.description: Shadow offset/blur steps in px (see --shadow-* in themes/shadow.css).

--prompt-input-placeholder-color.description: Supporting text on surfaces: descriptions, metadata, placeholders.

--prompt-input-font-family.description: Body text and most UI text.

--prompt-input-duration.description: Small state changes: hover, press, toggle.

--prompt-input-easing.description: Moving between two states on screen.
